title: Bind five evidence-lock adapters to the current TargetRoot commit
goal: Reject correctly rehashed evidence locks whose targetCommit differs from TargetRoot HEAD without broadening capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Solution, Assembly, Frontend, Database and compiled-Type adapters resolve ordinary checkout and worktree HEAD identities without launching Git or broadening reviewed capabilities.

Each adapter rejects a correctly rehashed wrong-targetCommit lock as error/integrity-failure; Assembly also binds Solution lineage and compiled-Type binds Solution and Assembly lineage to the same commit.
All five focused suites retain their existing positive and negative coverage, adapter hashes are rebound in module manifests, and immutable inputs remain unchanged.
Isolated IFX Package regression, Formal Pre and exact committed Formal Diff pass before fresh C6c5 parallel certification is attempted.
